_meta.description: Flavour-family buckets: each of the 71 odour descriptor words maps to exactly one of 10 families. The engine's flavor_wheel aggregates an ingredient's compound descriptors into these families. Taste-active classes (bitter/pungent) are a separate overlay, not odour families.
_meta.status: Approved by Ari (bartender review, Phase 3 gate) — 10 families, as-is.
_meta.coverage: all 71 odour descriptor words in compound_descriptors.json are assigned; no orphans.

taste_overlay.description: Non-volatile tastants have no odour; they colour a wheel as a separate taste ring rather than an odour family.
